name: Otherworldly Escort
oracle_text:
Flash
When this creature dies, if it's not a Spirit, return it to the battlefield under its owner's control with four charge counters on it. It's a Spirit Detective. (It's no longer a Human.)
{1}{W}, {T}, Remove a charge counter from this creature: Destroy target creature that dealt damage to you this turn.
blocked_sentences: When this creature dies, if it's not a Spirit, return it to the battlefield under its owner's control with four charge counters on it. It's a Spirit Detective. (It's no longer a Human.)
{1}{W}, {T}, Remove a charge counter from this creature: Destroy target creature that dealt damage to you this turn.

needs.what: a return-to-battlefield from graveyard (return_from_graveyard with counters) whose returned object permanently has its creature types REPLACED by a printed list ("It's a Spirit Detective. (It's no longer a Human.)"), applied as part of the return so the new object enters with those types; plus the dies trigger's intervening-if reading the dying object's last-known subtypes ("if it's not a Spirit")
needs.why_existing_wont_do: return_from_graveyard takes counters/tapped/controller but no subtype override; add_subtype only adds (Human would remain); animate's subtypes is a becomes-a-creature overlay with a duration, not a permanent creature-type replacement on a freshly returned object; set_creature_types exists only as a static_effect, which the card itself cannot carry for the returned object without also affecting its first life

needs.what: a selector key matching creatures that dealt damage (any damage, combat or not) to a given player this turn, e.g. {"dealt_damage_to": "you", "this_turn": true}, backed by a per-turn ledger of source -> damaged player
needs.why_existing_wont_do: damaged_by matches objects that were dealt damage BY a source (the reverse direction), damaged only reads marked damage on the object, and the value damage_taken_this_turn is a player total with no link to which creatures dealt it
